**The drop looks more like an expectations reset than proof the AI trade is falling apart.** $NVDA fell 6.38% [C1] after reporting adjusted EPS of $0.68 [E10], above the $0.63 estimate [E2]. But a stock can fall after a beat if investors had priced in an even stronger outlook. Reuters described Nvidia’s forecast as largely in line, disappointing investors accustomed to much larger beats [E12].

Your time horizon, need for the money, tolerance for further losses and overall exposure to Nvidia matter. I have moderate confidence in the expectations-reset explanation, but no one can identify every seller’s motive or rule out further declines.

This is research, not investment advice.
